And on the wall in the center appeared an image of me looking up at the stars in the sky.
「“Watch all you like, you bastards. The price of admission will be your lives in the end.”」
[The 'Fruit of Good and Evil' says, 'Do you really have the right to speak of ■■?']
My words kept appearing on the screen.
「“Yoo Joonghyuk, I know a 'future you don't know.'”」
「“Joonghyuk, we can save the world. You know that, right?”」
「“I'll end your story for you.”」
A shameless voice, without the slightest hesitation.
[The 'Fruit of Good and Evil' says, 'You, who have lived all this time deceiving all those worlds so thoroughly with a story only you knew······ Do you deserve to be saved?']
Deep within my heart, I heard something break.
The world was shaking.
[The 'Fourth Wall' glares at the 'Fruit of Good and Evil'!]
[The 'Fruit of Good and Evil' recoils in surprise.]
Tzzzzzzzt!
A storm of probability engulfing the surroundings.
Someone shouted to me as I staggered.
「(······Dokja-ssi! Hurry, you need to move. Michael is still―)」
When I opened my eyes, I was leaning against the wall of a cave.
“If you hadn't woken up in another minute, I was going to leave you.”
The blond woman was looking down at me. My abdomen and chest were swathed in bandages, and my thigh, pierced all the way through, was wrapped in crushed medicinal herbs.
Warm liquid flowed into my mouth. A bitter, metallic taste.
When I suddenly came to my senses, I realized what the liquid was and recoiled.
Having cut her own palm, Anna Croft was feeding me her blood.
Calming me with one hand, Anna Croft explained, entirely unruffled.
“I have the [Elixir Maker] attribute. My blood carries the medicinal effects of all the elixirs I've consumed.”
“······If I drink enough of this blood, I'll become your vassal.”
“Only if your Status is lower than mine.”
Anna Croft turned her head as she staunched the wound in her palm.
It was night outside. I could sense no presence.
After taking a slow, deep breath, I asked.
“What happened to Michael?”
“······He died. No, I'm not sure I can say he died······.”
“Was his incarnation body covered in black mist, by any chance?”
“······How did you know?”
I wanted to explain, but the pain pressing down on my head made it hard to recall the contents of 'Ways of Survival.'
Michael probably had not died. More precisely, he had died, but would come back to life.
Outside the cave hung the 'two moons,' symbols of second-generation Stories.
Anna Croft's face was pale in the dim moonlight. She seemed to have fed me quite a lot of blood.
“Why didn't you just leave me and go?”
“I only thought I might get a Story like 「The Prophet Who Repaid a Kindness」 if I kept you alive.”
Anna Croft, too, would know that Stories of that kind were not so easily made.
Something inside me suddenly rebelled. The Anna Croft I knew was not like this. She was utterly cold-blooded, never hesitating to sacrifice precious companions for the greater cause.
That was certainly how she ought to be······.
“You should be able to move in a few more hours.”
But was what I knew really all there was to Anna Croft?
「Anna Croft is an incarnation of 'Absolute Good.'」
······I did not know why I was thinking like this. Perhaps eating the [Fruit of Good and Evil] had given me too much to think about.
I spoke as though sighing.
“Let's part ways here. You should have collected all your modifier blocks too.”
“I don't mind, but will you be all right?”
“I'm not sure who should be worrying about whom. Even without your care, I wouldn't have died. My wounds weren't fatal.”
“No. Left as you were, you died.”
Not 'would have died,' but 'died.'
I knew when Anna Croft spoke that way.
“You shouldn't be able to read my future.”
“······Until recently, I couldn't.”
[Activating the exclusive skill 'Lie Detection Lv.7'!]
[You have confirmed that the statement is true.]
“Yesterday, I suddenly began seeing glimpses of your future. Something beyond a faint wall······.”
······She could see my future?
“What future did you see?”
“······You would be better off not knowing.”
“Tell me.”
Anna's [Great Demon's Eyes] were glowing ominously.
After a soft sigh, Anna Croft slowly spoke.
“Twelve hours from now, you will die at the hands of the Supreme King, Yoo Joonghyuk.”
[You are a regressor in the '1st round.']
The first time he chose to regress, he thought he had gained an opportunity.
An opportunity to survive the scenarios with more information than anyone else.
[You are a regressor in the '2nd round.']
The second time he chose to regress, he thought this life might not be easy.
Watching his companions die, again and again.
Losing the lover he cherished.
He realized that he would have to experience this many times in the future. He would pay for having more information than others by losing his precious companions over and over again.
[You are a regressor in the '3rd round.']
At his third regression, he thought this might be a curse.
「How many more times must I live like this?」
He realized he had to kill his own emotions to reach the end of all these scenarios.
He could not allow himself to live his own life.
So he decided to become a 'regressor,' rather than 'Yoo Joonghyuk.'
The fourth, the fifth······ Days he might have gone on to live.
It was the words of someone unexpected that stopped him from regressing.
―Being able to regress whenever you want must mean 'death' has no meaning. But if death has no meaning, life loses its value, too.
―Yoo Joonghyuk, get a grip. I'm telling you not to fool yourself into thinking things will get better if you repeat them a few times.
And so Yoo Joonghyuk did not move on to the next round.
He gave up the lives he could have lived again and again, starting from a more advantageous position with more advantageous information.
[You have reached 'Middle Island 3'!]
Middle Island 3, where he arrived in a dazzling shaft of light.
The participants who arrived on the island with him were murmuring.
[What is this place?]
[Weren't we going straight to the 'Main Island'?]
Yoo Joonghyuk drew his sword.
[Hidden scenario ― 'Snatching Modifiers' has begun!]

Then the slaughter began. Constellations' heads flew amid the blood-red sword winds. Yoo Joonghyuk's blade did not hesitate. He cut hearts out of incarnation bodies and smashed in the backs of fleeing constellations' heads.
[You have acquired modifier syllables from the constellation 'Crow of the Gloomy Sea at Night.']
[You have acquired modifier syllables from the constellation 'Beachfront Tactician.']
There were difficult enemies too.
Enemies who would have been difficult to face in the original third round.
Yet Yoo Joonghyuk dispatched even those enemies with ease.
「The 'Birch Tree's Scorpion' is vulnerable beneath its tail.」
「Attack the 'Sovereign of the Crescent Moon' when the starlight on its head vanishes.」
Information the original Yoo Joonghyuk would not have known.
Information he could only have learned after the fourth, fifth, hundredth, and then thousandth rounds.
[You have acquired modifier syllables from the constellation 'Birch Tree's Scorpion.']
[You have acquired modifier syllables from the constellation 'Sovereign of the Crescent Moon.']
The third-round Yoo Joonghyuk knew information from a future he had not yet reached.
『Han Sooyoung― Record of the 1863rd Round (Part I).』
『Han Sooyoung― Record of the 1863rd Round (Part II).』
A record of the 1863rd round in the very distant future, which he might have reached had his life followed its original course.
Whooooo―
Less than an hour later, everything around Yoo Joonghyuk had fallen quiet.
Shh-shhk!
After ending the last constellation's life, he continued on his way.
It was not simply to hurry through the scenario.
After he had walked for a while, a blood-drenched battlefield appeared.
[Forest of Abundance].
Countless dead incarnation bodies. A scene that looked as though someone had massacred them.
Gathering the 'modifier syllables' he needed, Yoo Joonghyuk followed the killer's trail.
Before long, he found a great cocoon shrouded in black.
Yoo Joonghyuk knew what that cocoon was.
“······A monster made by <Eden>.”
Michael's cocoon. It appeared when someone killed Michael after his 'Demon King Transformation.' Inside this cocoon, Michael would gain new life and be born again.
Just as Yoo Joonghyuk began the next 'round' after each death.
The difference was that Michael lost part of his memories each time he revived.
Evil created to eliminate evil.
Michael's existence was the reason he could never like <Eden>.
In the steadily falling rain, Yoo Joonghyuk examined the area around the cocoon.
Michael being in this state meant someone had defeated him.
Before long, Yoo Joonghyuk found fragments of a powerful Demon King's Stories. Someone had fought Michael and been badly wounded.
Traces of Stories glowing white in the haze of rain. They were traces of a being Yoo Joonghyuk knew well.
Twitch.
It was then that Michael's cocoon began to stir. With a sinister aura, the top of the cocoon was opening.
Yoo Joonghyuk frowned.
'Already?'
Dark emotion seeping rapidly through the violet mist. Michael's naked, newly formed incarnation body was coming into view through the opening in the cocoon.
Yoo Joonghyuk prepared to leave.
[De······mon··· King of Salvation······!]
Had Michael not said that, Yoo Joonghyuk would have simply left.
After a moment's hesitation, Yoo Joonghyuk approached the half-open cocoon. Not yet fully awakened, Michael lay asleep and defenseless inside it.
Flash. The instant Michael opened his eyes, Yoo Joonghyuk's sword moved.
“You'd better sleep a little longer.”
Shhkk!
[Splitting the Sky Energy] pierced Michael's heart.
The frail incarnation body, with neither [Demon King Transformation] nor [Angel Transformation] activated yet, crumbled helplessly under the second generation's probability.
Gaaaaaaaah!
[You have defeated the 177th incarnation body of the 'King of Corrupted Angels.']
Michael's cocoon shrank rapidly, then returned to its original state.
He would probably be born again in a 178th incarnation body.
[The nebula <Eden> expresses hostility toward your actions!]
[The constellation 'Scribe of Heaven' glares at you.]
Under the gazes pouring down from the sky, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
“······Didn't I tell you? I'm the one who will kill Kim Dokja. Don't do anything pointless.”
The sky gave no further answer.
Sheathing his sword, Yoo Joonghyuk hurried along the trail of fragments scattered through the forest.
After Yoo Joonghyuk disappeared down the forest path, a small shadow appeared beside Michael's cocoon. Short bobbed hair swaying out from beneath a pitch-black raincoat.
Seeing the items littering the area, the shadow's owner grinned broadly and spoke.
“When you're getting carried, nothing beats the protagonist's bus.”
Han Sooyoung hurriedly stuffed the items around her into her pockets, giddy with delight.
“Honestly, that regressor bastard doesn't appreciate how valuable items are······.”
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' gazes down at a Story fragment on the ground.]
“What're you looking at?”
Han Sooyoung picked up the fragment the Black Flame Dragon indicated.
Then she went rigid.
[You have acquired the Story fragment 'King of a Kingless World.']
“Don't tell me this is······.”
There were countless kinds of Stories in the <Star Stream>, but as far as she knew, only one person possessed a Story with that name.
She flung aside the items she had picked up and began running down the path where Yoo Joonghyuk had disappeared.
I would die at Yoo Joonghyuk's hands.
「(Dokja-ssi.)」
Three hours from now, I would die at Yoo Joonghyuk's hands.
「(Dokja-ssi!)」
I abruptly raised my head and answered.
'Yes, Yoo Sangah-ssi.'
「(How long are you going to stay in a daze? This isn't like you, Dokja-ssi.)」
'I'm not in a daze. I was thinking.'
「(About what?)」
'A way to persuade him.'
To be honest, I was not confident.
The Yoo Joonghyuk coming to kill me now was not the Yoo Joonghyuk of 'Ways of Survival' whom I had read about for over ten years.
The Yoo Joonghyuk who would come for me now was 'Yoo Joonghyuk, who had learned that he was a character.'
Like the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round.
「(Is it because you feel guilty······?)」
Sometimes Yoo Sangah seemed to know exactly what was inside me.
······And now, perhaps she really did.
“No. It's because this is something I have to do.”
[The power of the 'Fruit of Good and Evil' stokes your guilt.]

Perhaps these feelings had been forcibly triggered by the [Fruit of Good and Evil]. In other words, perhaps they were not my own. Even so, I believed this was what I had to do. Anna Croft, supporting me at my side, spoke.
“We'll reach the center of the island soon.”
I nodded.
The island's center.
Where the portal to the next scenario stood, and where I would meet Yoo Joonghyuk in three hours.
“I don't want to interfere with the future you've chosen······ But what I see with [Future Sight] doesn't change easily.”
“······Are you cursing me?”
“I'm only telling you the truth. Unless you want to die, you'd be better off finding the syllable 'sin' now and moving on to the next scenario.”
“I'm deliberately staying. There's something I have to talk to him about.”
A conversation I had kept putting off.
But one we absolutely had to have.
“A conversation······. Does the Supreme King even know how to have one?”
“If he doesn't, I'll have to teach him.”
Anna Croft fell silent for a moment. Whatever she was thinking, her eyes lifted toward the dark blue night sky.
A few constellations were looking down at us.
“As you know, you can't always persuade everyone.”
Anna Croft was a prophet. She had probably faced situations like mine many times. She would have come this far by deceiving Selena Kim, by deceiving Iris.
“I think you should only say that after you've tried everything you can.”
“A person who knows the future must shoulder that much responsibility.”
In the distance, the center of the island began to come into view.
A great portal to the next scenario stood there.
I moved aside the hand Anna Croft was using to support me and spoke.
“Well, this is where we part.”
Having collected every modifier syllable, Anna Croft had now earned the right to pass through that gate. She would advance toward the destination she sought.
The moment I turned away, Anna Croft called to me.
“Kim Dokja.”
Not the constellation 'Demon King of Salvation,' but 'Kim Dokja.' She was calling me.
“My goal is to change the owner of this <Star Stream>.”
At that moment, I felt deeply uncomfortable.
Because I could predict what she would say next.
“What is your goal?”
······As expected.
“Do I have to answer?”
“I think I need to hear it to decide whether to keep you alive.”
She had placed me on the scales. Whether I would help her achieve her goal or stand in her way.
If I stood in her way, she would eliminate me here without mercy.
I looked steadily into Anna Croft's eyes.
Could I tell this woman?
What I truly wanted in this world.
As a prophet, could she understand me?
But before I could properly begin, someone's voice rang out.
“His goal is to see the end of some trivial story.”
A voice laced with cold anger.
A voice I knew better than anyone.

title: A Story That Can't Be Shared

paragraphs.text: A Story That Can't Be Shared
Her expression stiffening, Anna Croft quietly drew a dagger behind her back.
“······Supreme King.”
Regardless, Yoo Joonghyuk strode forward.
“Birds of a feather, I see. Do you feel some kinship because you both know the future?”
“······You know about the future too, don't you?”
“What I experienced wasn't the future.”
Rumble!
“Those were all ‘things that had happened’. The past.”
Things that had happened.
The story I had read was one Yoo Joonghyuk had lived through in his own flesh.
Dying thousands of times.
As though responding to those years, the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] in his hand howled fiercely.
Anna Croft glanced at me.
I said,
“Go. He came to see me.”
“I hope next time I can hear your goal from your own mouth.”
With those words, Anna Croft vanished into the portal.
Certainly, she had no reason to stay now. Helping me this far had more than repaid her debt.
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't stop her. Normally, he would have pursued her relentlessly and cut her throat, but he didn't.
“Yoo Joonghyuk.”
I called him. Yoo Joonghyuk didn't look at me. He merely gazed into the empty portal entrance.
I called him once more.
“Listen to me. You did call me your companion once, after all.”
Turning toward me, Yoo Joonghyuk slowly drew his sword.
“Once.”
I couldn't fathom the anger in that cold voice.
[Activating the exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’!]
And so, once again, I step into the curse of omniscience (全知).
[Your understanding of this person is insufficient!]
But Yoo Joonghyuk's inner world wouldn't admit me.
As though the person before me wasn't the one I'd known until now.
“I know what you're going to say. About that book.”
“You looked into my life through that story, and made my life your entertainment. Is there anything else I need to know?”
I couldn't make excuses. It was true.
What I'd done was no different from what the constellations had done.
I knew. I knew that. But······.
But was that all there was to his sense of betrayal?
[Your understanding of this person gradually rises!]
Yoo Joonghyuk waited for me. Like a judge searching for a clue to a false accusation—a clue he had never managed to find.
But I didn't know what to say, or how.
His emotions, flowing in through ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, were filling my mind with darkness.
The sentences I knew were being covered by sentences I didn't know.
The words I should have said, and the words I wanted to say, were buried and lost beneath those pitch-black waves of emotion.
Then Yoo Joonghyuk's sword moved.
Even then, it didn't feel real. That he would truly kill me. That he would kill me, leaving behind all the time we'd spent together.
[The ‘Fruit of Good and Evil’ influences your emotions!]
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ shakes violently!]
The moment I saw the sword tip come within inches of my face, resentment surged alongside guilt.
[The ‘Fruit of Good and Evil’ draws out your dark emotions!]
I had tried quite hard.
Since the scenarios began, I'd really put everything I had into living.
I'd done my best, in my own way, to put what I'd read into practice.
I had never meant to hurt Yoo Joonghyuk or my companions.
I had thought only of the scenarios. How could I reduce the harm? How could I reliably reach an intact ending?
That was all. That was all it had been.
How on earth had things come to this?
Claaaang!
Bright blue sparks flew with a sharp clash.
“What are you standing there staring for, idiot!”
Han Sooyoung was there.
It wasn't by chance that Han Sooyoung came to Middle Island 3.
While undertaking the Small Island scenario, she had dreamed.
A dream of a man in a white coat killed by a man in a black coat.
It was an old, meaningless dream, so as she dreamed it, Han Sooyoung muttered, ‘This dream again.’
A dream was only a dream, after all, and dreams didn't happen in reality.
Just as a novel couldn't become reality.
—My third-round self is rather dim. Still not getting it after seeing the same scene over and over······.
‘What?’
Startled, Han Sooyoung turned toward the voice.
A woman in a black coat stood there. A similar build to hers. A face she couldn't see, as though someone had deliberately erased it.
That face kept speaking.
—However I look at it, your round seems headed for ruin at this rate······.
Feeling an instinctive fear, Han Sooyoung stepped back a couple of paces. But this was her dream. No one could run away inside their own dream.
—You know, I really like wrecking other people's schemes.
The moment the figure in the dream reached out, information she couldn't understand flowed into Han Sooyoung's mind.
[The power of ‘Predictive Plagiarism’ awakens within you!]
Then Han Sooyoung woke. Information she couldn't understand drifted through her head, and her consciousness began piecing it together through deduction, all on its own.
Soon, the following sentence appeared in her mind.
—Yoo Joonghyuk will head to Middle Island 3.

She didn't know why that sentence had come to mind. Still, Han Sooyoung decided to try following it. She didn't know what this mysterious dream was or who the figure in it was, but she felt that she ‘had to’.
And Han Sooyoung reached this place.
“Move. I have no business with you.”
Yoo Joonghyuk, glaring at her with a terrifying look.
Kim Dokja, staring at her with a dazed expression.
Han Sooyoung slowly drew a breath.
She didn't know what the dream wanted to show her. But at this moment, she understood her role.
Wearing her usual insolent grin, she spoke.
“I knew you'd cause trouble someday. That ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ wouldn't change so easily.”
“If you don't move······.”
“What, you'll kill me? What will that gain you? Will it compensate for all the time you've been deceived?”
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't answer. Instead, his sword tip vanished.
With a faint laugh, Han Sooyoung met his sword as it shot through the air.
“······Honestly, you and Kim Dokja are exactly alike when it comes to not listening.”
[The constellation, ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’, roars!]
The power of [Black Flame] dwelling throughout her body collided with his sword tip.
With the power of the second generation behind them, Yoo Joonghyuk's sword strikes were heavy. Biting her lip until it bled, Han Sooyoung unleashed her power.
Yoo Joonghyuk was strong. But she hadn't spent her time doing nothing, either.
[The Story, ‘Disciple of the Legendary Swordmaster’, shines!]
A Story she had barely managed to obtain before coming here, with every ounce of effort she could muster.
A swordmaster's power surged through her entire body.
Bzzzzzt!
Perhaps not elsewhere, but here.
“When someone talks······.”
Through dark-blue sparks, [Black Flame] transformed into aura surged toward Yoo Joonghyuk.
“You! Should! Listen!”
Bundles of aura pouring out with each clipped beat of her words.
Yoo Joonghyuk's gaze wavered at the unexpectedly fierce resistance.
Han Sooyoung seized the opening and shouted.
“Kim Dokja just read a novel! A horribly boring, long novel!”
Watching Yoo Joonghyuk give ground little by little, she thought she could do it.
This wasn't a complicated conflict. A misunderstanding born of words people had put together.
So she believed it could be resolved with words.
“Talk! Open up and talk to each other! Like other people!”
The persistent [Black Flame] was spreading onto Yoo Joonghyuk's sword.
Coldly shaking it off, he said,
“You don't know.”
“I do.”
Han Sooyoung growled at the way his cold tone shut her out.
“What makes you so furious? That Kim Dokja approached you already knowing about you? You're the same. Just like him, you've known things ahead of everyone else and deceived other people.”
Perhaps those words lit the spark. Anger entered Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes, too.
Their swords clashed in midair again.
“Of course I know you were sincere. I know you did it to save those people, to reach a better world. ······What do you think Kim Dokja was doing?”
“What kind of person throws their own life away because a character is going to die!”
Seeing his sword hesitate, Han Sooyoung kept pouring out words.
“Have you forgotten what Kim Dokja has done until now? Are you going to deny everything you've built in the third round just because he read that boring novel?”
Yoo Joonghyuk's Status was shrinking back.
Almost there. Han Sooyoung could feel it.
One more sentence, and she could stop this unnecessary fight.
“Calm down and think.”
But at the last moment, she took a wrong step.
“You're not that kind of character.”
“······Character?”
Yoo Joonghyuk's expression was changing.
It wasn't a question.
She realized her mistake too late. She couldn't take back what she'd already said.
“You're the same, too.”
Immense waves of magic power began spreading between their crossed blades.
Han Sooyoung's sword cried out in pain. The waves of [Black Flame] were being overwhelmed.
[The Story, ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’, roars!]
The [Giant Story] Yoo Joonghyuk had built was running wild.
“I saw what your 1863rd-round self did.”
“The 1863rd round? What are you—”
At that moment, something occurred to Han Sooyoung.
—The worldline of Ways of Survival's 1863rd round. ······Oh, you were there too. Though I don't know which one is the main body.
Kim Dokja had certainly said that once.
‘Could it be?’
Information coming together in her head.
She existed in the 1863rd round, too.
And there, she was living through another round.
Then that figure in the dream······.
The moment Han Sooyoung reached her answer, a split-second opening appeared.
Yoo Joonghyuk's sword didn't miss it.
Why couldn't I move?
Why hadn't I fought alongside Han Sooyoung?
Watching her speak for me, why couldn't I raise my voice with hers?
“You······ aren't good at telling your own story.”
I gathered Han Sooyoung into my arms as she lay looking up at me.
Blood poured from her waist in surges. Blood so vivid and red it didn't feel real.
Bleeding, she spoke.
“Kim Dokja. I know the ending you want.”
A playful smile, as always.
As though wiping away the blood on my cheek, Han Sooyoung brushed it with her hand and murmured,
“You poor bastard······.”
Staunching her bleeding, I frantically took out medicinal ingredients.
Her internal injuries were too severe. A merciless wound.
Second-generation sword aura had completely destroyed her insides.
I could save her.
If I had just a little more time.
If I found a proper physician and got her treated.
······But could I?
Han Sooyoung's hand, resting against my cheek, fell limply.
I called Han Sooyoung's name. Over and over, then over and over again.
But Han Sooyoung didn't rise.
Instead, I heard Yoo Joonghyuk's voice.
“Stand up, Kim Dokja.”
A voice in which I could sense neither guilt nor agitation.
At that moment, something snapped inside me, too.
I slowly rose.
[Yoo Joonghyuk.]
Stories seethed in my head.
—Some Stories are so large they're difficult to read properly. If you don't keep your balance, they can sweep you away at any time.
Yoo Hoseong had said that.
I knew it well, too. The larger the Stories grew, the heavier my burden became.
That was why I had gathered companions. We built a history together, created Stories.
To reach a different ending from Yoo Joonghyuk's in the original novel, I had come this far.
And this was the result.
Should I keep reading a story like this?
[The Giant Story, ‘Demon Realm's Spring’, begins its story.]
I had imagined an end we would all reach together.
I had believed such a story was surely possible.
[The Giant Story, ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’, begins its story.]
But if that was impossible.
If all the time I'd put in until now had been utterly useless.
[Activating ‘Demon King Transformation’.]
The ending I dreamed of no longer meant anything.
[I will kill you, Yoo Joonghyuk.]
「“I will kill you, Yoo Joonghyuk.”」
Everyone in the library was watching that sentence.
「(······One wrong turn, and we might all die.)」
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ vibrates violently!]
The entire library was shaking. Neatly arranged books fell into disarray. Yet no librarian was putting them back.
「(How frustrating. Why won't they talk? They really don't have enough desire to become one.)」
「(What did our poor Sooyoung ever do······.)」
The squid poked its round eyes with its legs.
The sentences continue.
Whenever Yoo Joonghyuk's and Kim Dokja's swords collided, Nirvana's teeth chattered.
「(Hey, rookie. What do you think?)」
At those words, Yoo Sangah turned toward the librarians, catching books flying overhead one by one.
Her hands were full of Kim Dokja's memories. The books she had been reading until a moment ago.
「(Well, I have two thoughts.)」
「(First, Sooyoung-ssi isn't dead. I know her well. She's not someone who'd risk her life for something like this.)」
The weeping squid's eyes widened.
「(What? But you saw it too.)」
「(You still don't understand. The heroine drops her hand and loses consciousness right there. Then the male protagonist awakens! In every movie I've seen—)」
Whatever the squid and Simulation said, Yoo Sangah quietly continued.
「(Second, the two of them are talking.)」
Looking at the accumulating sentences, she said,
「(Though no one in the world would call that a ‘conversation’.)」
Story fragments spill from a split arm.
The Stories we had built.
[The Story, ‘Demon Realm's Spring’, pours out its story!]
[The Story, ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’, growls!]
Story collides with Story, like a dragon and tiger grappling.
Possessing the same ‘Giant Stories’ as me, Yoo Joonghyuk was answering with the same power.
[You hold the larger stake in this Story!]

Despite my larger stake, the shares of the Stories belonging to Yoo Joonghyuk wouldn't listen to me. Perhaps it was because of the years he had accumulated. He had continued his story more fiercely than anyone in the <Star Stream>.
Bzzzzzt!
Second-generation probability was restraining us.
But some things couldn't be restrained.
[The Story, ‘One Who Opposes the Extraordinary’, shouts!]

Declining though it was, <Hongik> remained the Korean Peninsula's leading nebula.
Under those circumstances, it could hardly have been easy for Cheok Jungyeong to oppose <Hongik>'s wishes and take my side.
[Many constellations take an interest in the clash between <Kim Dokja’s Company> and <Hongik>!]
Perhaps because of Cheok Jungyeong's declaration, I could feel the constellations focusing on me. Some watched me warily as a new wind blew through the neutral zone.
I looked at Pungbaek.
“Will you continue?”
Watching his eyelids tremble violently, I honestly didn't feel good about it either.
I had spoken as though condemning <Hongik>, but I knew that Pungbaek had not entirely abandoned the Korean Peninsula's scenarios.
Because Pungbaek was the very constellation who had lent my mother his power during the 'Returnee War.'
Even if, damn it, that had robbed my mother of her entire lifespan.
Maybe that was why I was so angry.
[The wind will not forget what happened today.]
After glaring at me for a long time, Pungbaek snapped his folding fan shut and vanished like dust.
[A considerable number of constellations admire your spirit!]
[A few constellations remember that <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s name is no empty boast.]
[The <Star Stream>'s gossipmongers record this incident.]
Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung, Jung Heewon, Lee Hyunsung.
They were all watching me, but none of their faces showed fear.
They were probably all thinking the same thing I was.
It didn't matter how others saw our nebula or what judgments they made.
We would simply move toward the story we believed was right.
[A choice worthy of you, successor.]
Cheok Jungyeong spoke as he watched us.

[Some constellations will like you and follow you for that quality. Indeed, many constellations on the Korean Peninsula now watch you more closely than <Hongik>. But······ the number of those hostile to you has grown as well.]
I became conscious of the surrounding gazes anew.
Some constellations glared at us. Others watched us with apparent envy. Still others shook their heads, their eyes seeming to say we would end up just like them.
「We, too, were once like you.」
The Stories the constellations had lived through felt close enough to touch.
[Ancient Giant Stories look at <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s Story.]
Every Story was a trace of overcoming a scenario.
Times that had once been someone's entertainment.

All the Stories that had come this far had let themselves be broken to survive. Time spent compromising with the reality of the <Star Stream>, agreeing to the demands of constellations and dokkaebis to stay alive. And so, at last, they stood here.
As though speaking for all that time, Cheok Jungyeong said.
[The <Star Stream> dislikes stories that will not break. All the more so when they are as pure as yours.]
Unbroken purity······.
I laughed at those words.
It surprised me that the world saw us that way.
Because those words denied every step of the road we had walked.
“We've already been broken dozens of times.”
<Kim Dokja’s Company> had not stood on its own two feet from the beginning.
Since the Korean Peninsula's scenarios began, we had come this far enduring the constellations' manipulations and inexplicable hatred. Just like countless other Stories.
“But every time, we got back up. That's why we're here now.”
To call us 'pure' after all that was an insult.
[The Giant Story 'Demon Realm's Spring' looks at you calmly.]
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' swallows a fierce cry.]
The two Giant Stories reacted as though agreeing with me.
“And we'll keep getting back up, as many times as it takes.”
[The germinating third 'Giant Story' stirs.]
And so did the third Giant Story that would soon awaken.
Watching us, Cheok Jungyeong slowly nodded.
[I will watch your story.]
With those words, he turned away. The constellations of the Korean Peninsula who followed him also departed, glancing back at us.
Cheok Jungyeong had now surpassed Historical-grade and reached Narrative-grade.
He had also been a constellation far longer than I had. A born fighter, he would be the finest ally if we could bring him to our side.
Of course, that applied only if we could fight on the same side.
Perhaps I had been striking a pose for too long. Han Sooyoung, watching beside me, tapped my shoulder.
―Hey, someone might mistake you for the protagonist.
Feeling awkward, I glanced at Yoo Joonghyuk. But he wasn't looking at me. He was gazing far off toward the horizon.
“It's begun.”
[A scenario event is occurring!]
[A local battle in the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' is scheduled near this area!]
At the next system message, neutral constellations and incarnations camped all around us sprang to their feet in alarm.
[Intervening in the conflict zone will present you with a choice of camps!]
In the distance, I could see two mighty forces advancing.
White-winged angels in dazzling armor led incarnations and reincarnators across the plain, coloring it silver.
From the other side, Demon Kings steeped in impure and demonic energy advanced with their vassals.
[The updated main scenario has arrived!]
<Main Scenario #80 ― 'Great War of Saints and Demons'>
Category: Main
Difficulty: Unmeasurable

Clear Conditions: Choose either the Absolute Good or Absolute Evil camp and participate in the Great War of Saints and Demons. As your camp accumulates victories in the scenario, its 'Good/Evil Points' will increase. Once a camp's points exceed 100, the outcome of the war will be decided.
Time Limit: This scenario's time limit is affected by 'Chaos Points.'
Reward: A Giant Story related to the 'Great War of Saints and Demons,' ???
Failure: Death
[Great War of Saints and Demons Progress]
Absolute Good Points: 56
Absolute Evil Points: 56
Chaos Points: 51
[Chaos Points increase the longer the Great War of Saints and Demons continues.]
[You must choose a camp to fight on this battlefield.]
[The earlier you choose a camp, the greater your scenario rewards.]
We read the scenario details in silence for a moment.
Han Sooyoung was the first to speak.
“Kim Dokja, what do we do? Our usual thing again?”
[The constellation 'Hell's Scribe' says that the hottest places in Hell are reserved for those who remain neutral in times of moral crisis······.]
“He won't stop babbling, and that isn't even his own line. Seriously.”
[The constellation 'Hell's Scribe' flinches and falls silent.]

'Hell's Scribe' was Dante, author of the 『Divine Comedy』. And that famous saying of Dante's had actually been adapted by a politician of a later age. Still, since it had helped make him famous, Dante would have accepted it as his own Story.
「The hottest places in Hell are reserved for those who remain neutral in times of moral crisis.」
It sounded impressive. Though I didn't know what it meant in a world where even moral choices became someone else's entertainment.
“This time, we have to choose too. We can't keep slipping out of it forever.”
Regardless of Dante's words, we, too, faced a choice between two alternatives. We couldn't participate in this 'Great War of Saints and Demons' at all without choosing Good or Evil.
Looking at the message, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
“The 'Great War of Saints and Demons' in the 1863rd round ended in Evil's victory. Han Sooyoung sided with Evil.”
“Why is it me again? And this isn't the 1863rd round, you know?”
Han Sooyoung was right.
This was not the 1863rd round.
This was the third round, the world of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
“Let's go.”
In the distance, I could see a fierce battlefield where the two forces of Good and Evil were colliding.
One of the battlefields in this vast 'Great War of Saints and Demons' had just opened.
[The 113th local battle of the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' is occurring!]
[The list of participants in this local battle is revealed.]
And on the front line of that Great War of Saints and Demons stood a constellation I knew well.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' is participating in this scenario.]
“Spare me, please spare me.”
Shhkk!
“Archangel-nim, please······!”
Groans from all directions.
The incarnations who had chosen Evil from the two options were losing their heads to the archangels' swords.
This is a war of Stories.
Having to be utterly excluded by one side simply for belonging to the other's Story.
Leaving the fallen incarnations behind, Uriel surveyed the battlefield without expression.
Once, the archangel Uriel had pitied them.
She had grieved for the incarnations swept up and consumed in a vast narrative, and raged at their suffering. She had felt that way for a long time. Once, that had been her whole life.
'······I need to catch up on the Star Stream broadcasts.'
Watching the surging Demon King army, Uriel chewed on her lip.
Being born to spread Good does not mean one can spend an entire lifetime doing nothing else.
What truly wears a constellation down is not physical danger, but the erosion of the mind.
Emotional labor sustained over eons had brought her a deep-rooted disillusionment with the world itself, and profound madness.
[The soul of the constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' trembles unsteadily.]
Strong or weak, no constellation can feel safe within the scenarios.
That is the kind of system a scenario is.
Roooooar!

To forget that they are being consumed within the scenarios. And to live one more day, constellations consume other Stories. They watch scenarios voyeuristically, rage at someone's plight, hurl abuse, feel admiration, or are moved.
The archangel Uriel was no exception.
[■■■■■ Get lost! I missed the live broadcast because of you!]

[Hell Flames Ignition] streamed from Uriel's blade, burning the Demon King's vassals to ash. In her haste, she failed to control her power properly. It was also largely because she had rushed into battle after summoning only half her true body.
[The Demon Kings participating in the local battle are astonished by the archangel's power!]
Of course, even if it was only half her body, it was still half the body of none other than the archangel Uriel.
Most Demon Kings could not hope to match her.
[The Demon King 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' releases his Status!]
[The Demon King 'Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour' unleashes his Giant Story!]
[The Demon King 'Speed of Sound Demon King' lets out a blood-red cry!]
[The Demon King 'Duke of Everywhere' is engulfed in excitement and madness!]
The problem was that the Demon Kings participating this time were no ordinary Demon Kings either.
Uriel's expression hardened as she watched the Demon Kings advance through her [Hell Flames Ignition].
[The mad archangel is right before us!]
[Do not fear! I, the Demon King Buer, am with you!]
They were not the Demon Kings originally scheduled to participate in this local battle. But the Demon King army had suddenly changed its lineup, leaving Uriel to face them alone.
[You ■■■! Get lost!]
Arrows laden with demonic energy filled the battlefield. Uriel activated [Hell Flames Ignition] like a barrier to block them.
While she looked after the lower angels retreating in haste, arrows lodged all over her own body too, before she knew it.
[How laughable. Angels, are you fleeing?]
[So much for the reputation of the 'Demon-like Judge of Fire'.]
[Shut up! If I could have descended with my whole true body, you'd all be dead.]
Under the barrage, Uriel fumed without so much as a groan.
[Stop ganging up on me like cowards and fight me one on one, you ■■! ■uck! One on one, I could wreck Agares, Gamigin, Marbas, any of them!]

The Demon Kings sneered at Uriel's furious cry. They knew she was strong. That was why no fewer than four Demon Kings had come to take down one archangel. And they remained meticulous to the very end.
[This is war, angel.]
Blood-drenched Uriel's [Hell Flames Ignition] clashed with the Demon Kings.
The archangel Uriel was strong.

With the power of only half her body, she had cut an arm off the 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' and crushed the pet dragon cherished by the 'Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour.' The 'Speed of Sound Demon King' had even lost both legs.
But that was as far as she got.
The moment she turned at a sudden chill, the transparent Duke of Everywhere's dagger came flying toward her heart.
[Today, I shall feast on an archangel's Story.]
Realizing her mistake, Uriel belatedly swung her sword. But her wounded incarnation body had grown sluggish, making it difficult to respond. And the next moment.
Shh-shhk!
A blade shining pure white pierced the Duke of Everywhere's chest from behind.
Black blood pattering down.
The sword stabbed his back again and again. Until Story fragments burst grotesquely from him and the ruined incarnation body's life was utterly extinguished.
Then a sword of white light flashed in and sent the Duke of Everywhere's head flying.
[Someone has killed the Demon King 'Duke of Everywhere.']
Then Uriel saw the two people standing behind the fallen Duke of Everywhere.
People she could have recognized from any distance were so close.
“I can't stand by and watch my constellation get beaten like that.”
Her one and only incarnation in this world.
And.
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has won the 'Demon King Promotion Battle'!]
[The Demon Realm grade is being adjusted!]
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has become the 'Demon King of the 50th Demon Realm'!]
The protagonist of the story she had watched for so long spoke.
“It's been a while, Uriel.”
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has chosen his camp.]
There are times when someone's expression feels utterly raw.
Moments when you feel you're seeing that person's true expression.
[Kim Dokja―!]
That was how Uriel looked to me now.
Reaching out with all her strength, Uriel embraced Jung Heewon and me, rubbing her cheek against us for a long time. Eventually, Jung Heewon scolded her.
“Uriel, I can't breathe.”
[S-sorry.]
Eyes still sparkling even as she drew back in embarrassment. Sometimes, I truly can't understand how such a silly archangel acquired the modifier 'demon-like.'

[How did you know to come here? Hm? Did the 'Kaizenix Archipelago' scenario go well? I barely managed to watch a few parts, but I didn't have much time······ I'm so sorry! You're not upset because I didn't donate anything, are you? I didn't do it on purpose―]
Not only her expression, but every word was utterly raw.
Listening to Uriel, Jung Heewon and I looked at each other. She was probably feeling what I felt.
Words without elegant phrasing or painstaking revision.
Yet some words are most moving when left raw.
“Uriel. I understand. But we should leave the details for later.”
[Hm? Oh, right. This isn't the time.]
Uriel's gaze shifted from me to the Demon King army glaring at us from across the way.
Seeing her expression turn cold in an instant, I realize my doubts were unfounded.
This angel is unmistakably a 'Demon-like Archangel of Fire.'
[The Demon King 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' cannot understand your actions.]
And there were Demon Kings standing against that archangel.
Tenth in the Demon King rankings, 'Buer,' Monarch of Stars and Logic.
Eighteenth in the Demon King rankings, 'Bathin,' Speed of Sound Demon King.
Twenty-ninth in the Demon King rankings, 'Astaroth,' Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour.
Even excluding the Duke of Everywhere, who had died at my hands, three Demon Kings remained. Every one of them was a formidable enemy.
Especially the 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' and the 'Speed of Sound Demon King.'
If both Buer's arms or both Bathin's legs had been intact, I might have had to risk my life here.
[Demon King of Salvation!]
[What is the meaning of this? Why are you fighting your fellow Demon Kings?]
I shrugged shamelessly and made an excuse.
“I was just fighting a Promotion Battle.”
[You think that excuse makes any sense right now······.]
“There's no law against attempting a Demon King Promotion Battle during the 'Great War of Saints and Demons,' is there? It happened often during the 'First Great War of Saints and Demons,' too.”
Enraged by my words, Bathin looked vicious enough to tear my head off immediately. But with both legs gone, there was nothing he could do.
[You have reenacted part of the 'First Great War of Saints and Demons'!]
[The Demon King 'Asmodeus' takes an interest in your unexpected actions.]
In fact, what I had done was exactly what the Demon King Asmodeus had done in the First Great War of Saints and Demons.
His expression hardening, Buer, the 'Monarch of Stars and Logic,' asked.
[Do you think you will get away with this?]
“Of course I won't.”
Not remotely cowed by their auras, I raised my Status.
“But I'm not the one who should be worried right now.”
[Releasing the Demon King's Status!]
[Activating the exclusive skill 'Bookmark'!]
[Bookmark slot 5 has been activated!]
[The exclusive skill 'Electrification (電人化) Lv.23(+13)' has been activated.]
[Your current body composition differs from that of the corresponding character.]
[Your 'Status' overcomes the penalty imposed by your physical conditions.]
The sensation of wings breaking through my skin made my shoulders itch.
With the tingling sensation of Electrification added to it, my whole body was enveloped in lightning.
The three Demon Kings looked bewildered as my 'Status' soared.
The 'Monarch of Stars and Logic,' missing one arm.
The 'Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour,' missing his pet dragon and covered in wounds.
And the 'Speed of Sound Demon King,' already out of the running as a fighting force with both legs gone.
Beside me, Jung Heewon drew her [Sword of Judgement] and activated [Demon Slaying].
“I was disappointed that my last fight with a Demon King got cut short······.”
As the Demon Kings began backing away, Uriel quickly grew triumphant and spoke.
[You ■■ were running your mouths just fine earlier, weren't you? Go on, say something else!]
[Dokja, Heewon. Let's go! Let's wreck every one of those Demon King ■■······!]

I caught Uriel's shoulder as she advanced in a fury, dragging her ruined incarnation body along. A shoulder that had become so frail. Helpless in my grasp, Uriel turned to me with wide, startled eyes.
“Uriel, please step back.”
[Hm? Oh······ Are you worried about me? It's fine. I'm Uriel!]
Looking touched, she clasped my hand tightly. The sight saddened me a little, and I smiled quietly.
“That isn't what I mean.”
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has chosen his camp.]
The announcement of my participation hung in the air. Uriel probably hadn't read it properly.
Still puzzled, Uriel began to stiffen. Her eyes slowly widened.
Meeting her eyes, I spoke.
“Stay still, Uriel. This will be over soon.”
Perhaps, by now, she was reading the message I could see too.
[The camp chosen by the Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' is Evil (惡).]
“Kim Dokja's gone and done a Kim Dokja again.”
Watching the battlefield from afar, Han Sooyoung muttered.
The battlefield had been settling into a lull, but Kim Dokja's abrupt intervention was driving it toward chaos.
A Demon King who had killed a Demon King. A Demon King who, even so, made no attempt to hide that he was 'Evil.'
She could see the lower angels moving to surround Kim Dokja, and Jung Heewon's troubled face.
Seemingly worried, Lee Hyunsung asked.
“Is he really going to be all right doing that?”
“And if he isn't? Should we tell him to side with <Eden> now? Kim Dokja's a born Demon King.”
Grumbling, Han Sooyoung looked toward Yoo Joonghyuk.
“You're not just going to watch, are you?”
“Of course not.”
“No need to ask. I'm choosing Evil (惡).”
Han Sooyoung's constellation sponsor was the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon.'
She hadn't had much of a choice to begin with.
“What about you, Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“What does your sponsor say? No answer?”
Instead of answering, Yoo Joonghyuk looked at the incarnation bodies strewn across the battlefield. Some were the corpses of angels and Demon Kings, but most were human―reincarnators.
“See anyone you know?”

Silently, Yoo Joonghyuk looked down at the fallen reincarnators. A few who were still writhing reached toward him. Their wounds were too severe; it was too late to save them. He bent down and drove his dagger into their throats. Then they fell asleep with peaceful expressions.
Watching this, Yuri di Aristel spoke.
「Sooyoung.」
'Don't worry, Yuri. I won't let that happen to you.'
She can see the dead reincarnators' souls scattering.
Trapped in the mandala's cycle, reincarnators would live again even if they died on this island. But their immortality did not mean it was all right for them to die.
[A Giant Story that has lost its name ceases to exist.]
With every new scenario they are conscripted into, they lose more of their worlds. They forget the lives they once lived, and eventually, even death.
[The Most Ancient Good (善) urges the reincarnators toward Good.]
[The Most Ancient Evil (惡) forces the reincarnators to choose.]
Most of the dead had probably never thought about vast concepts like Good and Evil.
Han Sooyoung closed a dead reincarnator's eyes. With those eyes closed, the reincarnator's face was, of course, neither Good nor Evil.
[You must choose a camp to intervene on this battlefield!]
“I will choose my camp.”
As Yoo Joonghyuk spoke, Han Sooyoung narrowed her eyes and asked.
“You aren't thinking of trying something, are you? You two had a huge fight before we went to the Kaizenix Archipelago.”
Yoo Joonghyuk stared at her without answering. Han Sooyoung thought she could tell what he was thinking from his exasperated expression. Just as she was about to yell, he answered.
“This war must become our fight, rather than the 'Great War of Saints and Demons.' This must not be someone else's battlefield.”
Kim Dokja’s Company's fight, rather than the Great War of Saints and Demons.
Han Sooyoung immediately understood what he meant.
“Only then can both Good and Evil be denied victory. And that is probably how Kim Dokja wants this to unfold.”
“I understand what you mean, but that's a very hard road.”
Han Sooyoung immediately objected.
“That'll make enemies of both the Demon Realm and Eden at once.”
“You were the one who said this was not the 1863rd round.”
Han Sooyoung pouted, looking as though she'd taken a hit.
“Kim Dokja······ What a relentless bastard. He's the only one who'd come up with something like that and call it a solution in a situation like this.”
“He has always been like that.”
“So are you. You're exactly the same.”
At that, Yoo Joonghyuk answered bluntly.
“You don't seem so different yourself.”
“Whatever. I'm different from idiots like you. Enough talking. Let's get moving.”

In the distance, she could see Kim Dokja getting beaten up, surrounded by angels. Well, after he had abruptly declared himself Evil in the middle of that camp, it was understandable that <Eden>'s angels would tremble with a sense of betrayal.
Yoo Joonghyuk declared.
“I will not hold back.”
“Who said you should? I'm planning to kill you too if you piss me off.”
“Good. That should make it a fight worth having.”
“Let's settle our unfinished fight from Kaizenix right here.”
The two of them vanished toward the battlefield at the same time. Abruptly left alone, Lee Hyunsung wailed.
“W-wait! Sooyoung-ssi! Joonghyuk-ssi! What am I supposed to do?”
“Figure it out yourself!”
[The incarnation 'Han Sooyoung' has chosen her camp.]
[The incarnation 'Yoo Joonghyuk' has chosen his camp.]
[The camp chosen by the incarnation 'Han Sooyoung' is Evil (惡).]
[The camp chosen by the incarnation 'Yoo Joonghyuk' is Good (善).]
At last, their 'Great War of Saints and Demons' had begun.
The great plain of the Main Island, where all Heaven's forces had gathered.
Metatron, the leader of Heaven (天界), was receiving situation reports from the other Dominions inside a tent modeled after his office.
―<Olympus> has expressed its intention to participate.
―<Vedas> has also sent word that it will participate.
―<Papyrus> says it will send some constellations as well.
―<Asgard> has also declared its entry into the war. With its own Giant Story to deal with, it seems unlikely to send many constellations.
―There has been no contact yet, but we have seen movement from <Emperor> too. It has long been known for pursuing both peace and war······.
―'Hell's Scribe' is working diligently in the neutral zone. Thanks to those efforts, participation is reportedly rising sharply among both constellations and reincarnators.
Metatron took careful notes on every report, then transmitted appropriate responses.
This 'Great War of Saints and Demons' scenario—quite literally a war with the fate of Good and Evil at stake.
Accordingly, Metatron was being careful, very careful, with this scenario.
[This camp currently has 56 Absolute Good Points.]
And so far, the war had been proceeding smoothly.
Except for one special restriction added specifically to this 'Great War of Saints and Demons.'
[The current Chaos Point total is 51.]
Chaos Points. When he had asked about them, the Great Dokkaebi had answered.
―We very rarely provide a stage of this scale for a clash between old Giant Stories. So, in accordance with probability, there must be a corresponding risk.
―What do you mean?

―A detailed explanation would spoil the fun, so I won't go on. Just remember this. Whatever happens, you must not let the Chaos Points reach 100. Do you understand? Something truly terrible will happen if they do.
Great dokkaebis cared nothing for the fate of nebulas. They were obsessed solely with making more sensational scenarios. Chaos Points were probably the product of just such a wicked scheme.
[I'm bored, Scribe.]
It was Michael, sharpening his sword in a corner of the tent.
[I'll bring back Agares's head. Let me out.]

Defeated by Kim Dokja and Yoo Joonghyuk in the Middle Island scenario, Michael had tasted humiliation twice. He had restored his incarnation body through his resurrection power and entered the Main Island scenario. Metatron smiled faintly at him as he burned with determination.
[Then the war would end too quickly.]
[Isn't it better for a boring war to end quickly?]
[No. This war must be longer and more harrowing than any scenario that has ever existed.]

Metatron looked at the feeds transmitted from all across the region. Those who had chosen Good or Evil of their own will were raising weapons against one another. For now, they were mercenaries joining a war, but Metatron knew that would change as time passed.
[The Most Ancient Good (善) encourages the great holy war.]
Someday, the constellations participating in this war would hate one another in the names of Good and Evil. That hatred would burn anew, creating Stories for future generations.
Watching the war's progress, Michael spoke sullenly.
[Then at least let me finish off those <Kim Dokja’s Company> bastards. I owe them a debt.]
Metatron shook his head. <Kim Dokja’s Company> was an important variable in this scenario, a force to be used as much as possible while they could still be used.
[Perhaps before, but not now. I have another use for them. If you intervene, Michael―]
It was then that a scenario message sounded.
[The 113th local battle of the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' has been forcibly ended.]
Metatron checked the details attached to the message.
The 113th local battle was the one Uriel had joined.
[······Forcibly ended?]
No such message had ever appeared before.
Nor was that the end of the messages.
[Chaos Points have increased by 5.]
[The current Chaos Point total is 56.]
[Warning! Chaos Points have exceeded 55!]
[Something writhes in the hottest place in Hell.]
[The apocalyptic calamity that determines the end of all things begins to stir.]

title: Great War of Saints and Demons

paragraphs.text: Great War of Saints and Demons
Blue electricity sparked in the air, and the last charging android collapsed.
Pshhh.
Lee Jihye pulled her sword from the severed cables and wiped her forehead.
[Your level has increased!]
Watching beside her, Lee Gilyoung picked his nose and said,
“You're getting pretty good now, noona.”
At his sky-high arrogance, Lee Jihye nearly cracked him on the head, then stopped herself.
[You cannot attack the target.]
Those brats were invincible in this world anyway. Nothing good would come of upsetting them.
Lee Jihye looked between Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung and asked,
“What levels are you two now?”
“What? You were 83 just a few days ago!”
“That was a lie, stupid.”
Watching the two children bicker, Lee Jihye answered with a sigh.

Still, the two children were helping her level up fast. She was leveling at the speed of light, as though they were literally power-leveling her, and it had earned them a place on Next City's wanted list.
[Android Lee Jihye — 1888G]
To be precise, only she had made the list. Since the children couldn't be attacked in the first place, they weren't even listed as wanted.
“I think it's about time we got out of this world.”
“I think it'll end if we bring that down.”

Shin Yoosung pointed to the enormous tower occupying the heart of Next City. A battleship floated above its summit, and whenever Lee Jihye looked at it, she received a message from her constellation sponsor.
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ insists that you must obtain that Star Relic.]
“······Well, this is a first. Our frugal general, of all people.”
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ clears his throat.]
Still, Lee Jihye could understand how her sponsor felt.
Anyone would probably understand once they saw that battleship.
“I don't know why something like that's here, but······.”
If she could take it with her, the skies of all these worlds would become the Maritime War God's sea.
Tightening her grip on her sword, Lee Jihye said,
“It'd be fun to give ajusshi and Master a surprise. Kids, shall we clear this now?”
“Sure. I was getting tired of using bugs anyway.”
“Let's do that.”
The unexpected message came just as the three, now of one mind, started toward the tower.
[An emergency patch has been applied!]
[As of midnight today, a shutdown system will be introduced to this scenario.]
[From now on, players under eighteen will be unable to use this scenario between midnight and 6 a.m.]
Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung, who had been scampering along so cheerfully, staggered.
Lee Gilyoung murmured in confusion.
“Noona, I'm sleepy—”
“Unnie, run······!”

Thirty meters.
With the cannons loaded, Lee Jihye raised her sword.
With the Maritime War God’s blessing, the dragon figurehead glowed red-hot. At that very instant—
“Wait!”

We might die even if we fought for our lives, and now I was getting in the way?

“Huh?”
As if by magic, the wave of Good and Evil had stopped exactly ten meters away.
Tssssss!
As though something was exercising powerful control over it.

“……Why did they suddenly stop?”

A constellation and a Demon King were rising above the frozen tidal wave.
Metatron and Agares.
The two most powerful beings on this battlefield spoke in their True Voices for the first time.
[All constellations, cease your hostility and return to your positions!]
[The battle is temporarily suspended.]

The reason for it was written there.
[Chaos has exceeded 80.]
[The countdown to destruction begins.]
Chaos: 80.
The timing had been incredibly tight.
Neither the constellations nor the Demon Kings had saved us.
It was those with the least influence in this war.
“The reincarnators at the front probably clashed with members of their own camp as they were dying.”
Weak Good was still Good. Weak Evil was still Evil.
Good and Evil, intent only on killing us, were heading for destruction as the price of disregarding those ‘weaklings.’
[From now on, Chaos will increase by 1 point every 30 minutes.]
The rate of increase accelerated once Chaos exceeded 80. From now on, it would rise even without any clashes, reaching the critical point in exactly ten hours.
In other words, the Apocalypse Dragon’s resurrection was assured.
[Ancient calamities rejoice in the deepest depths of hell.]
The Apocalypse Dragon. One of the worst calamities in the history of the <Star Stream>.

[The Great Battlefield of the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’ is temporarily frozen.]
[The representatives of Good and Evil are currently holding emergency talks.]

[You have accomplished a feat no one has ever achieved!]
[A Myth-grade Story is germinating within you!]

[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ looks up at you with tearful eyes.]

[Chaos increases by 1.]

Good and Evil were probably united in badmouthing <Kim Dokja’s Company> and the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’

A writer’s instincts were certainly sharp.

Talks between Good and Evil. It sounded fine. But…… the Metatron I knew would never back down at a time like this. He would accept any sacrifice to put Absolute Good into full practice.
Looking at the gray sphere, I said,
“I don’t know what they’re plotting, but there is a way to find out what’ll happen next.”

I stared at Han Sooyoung. Her mouth fell open.
“Damn it. Right, we had that option.”
Talks or war, it would all be settled within the next nine hours.
And we knew someone who could read that sort of near future better than anyone else in this world.

“Hey, prophet!”

A fierce-looking Yoo Joonghyuk had Anna Croft by the collar.

Anna Croft said,

“It isn’t noise in the future. I can’t read it at all. It’s not that someone scribbled on the page. The page with the scribbles doesn’t exist in the first place.”
Han Sooyoung and I looked at each other.
A sense of foreboding crept over me, very slowly.
“Kim Dokja, this……”
Not scribbles on a page, but the page itself disappearing.

“……Surely not?”

[Chaos increases by 1.]
[Current Chaos: 83]
“It hasn’t been thirty minutes yet.”

[Members of the same camp have clashed!]
[Current Chaos: 84]
Someone was trying to destroy this world.
[Members of the same camp have clashed!]
[Current Chaos: 85]

Why try to bring about the world’s destruction?

‘Good and Evil’ were not all that existed here. Just as <Kim Dokja’s Company> was neither Good nor Evil, some pursued Stories we could never relate to.
Some lived to prevent destruction. Others lived for it.
Tssssss……!

Lee Jihye and the children set out first, followed by Han Sooyoung and me.

The little brat. Even when I was worrying about her.
—You be careful, idiot.

[Chaos is increasing!]
[Current Chaos: 86]

A Demon King’s vassal.

[Members of the same camp have clashed……!]
[Current Chaos: 87]

Krrrack!

[Members of the same camp have clashed!]

[Members of the same camp have clashed!]

Eliminating the cause of the rising Chaos.

Tssssss……!

[Members of the same camp have clashed!]

Her Story.
Gabriel moving her trembling lips.

A fragment of the Final Wall, deciding the world’s Good and Evil.

Metatron’s book, radiating pure white light.
